content.comment_body: Hello, At a customer's site, two [product_name] devices with memory modules [article_no] (yellow color) are installed. I removed the battery module and tried to upload data using the standard connection cable (USB/connector), but encountered transmission errors. The COM port selection is correct. I tried both [product_name] software [version_no], but there was still no communication. Switching the device to stop mode and selecting the correct hardware type ([article_no]) did not solve the problem, and both devices aren't connecting to my PC. However, in the same panel, a [product_name] with [article_no] is also installed, from which I was able to back up data using the same cable and software versions.

For older [product_name] devices, first set the module to STOP mode. Then navigate to an option related to 'CARD.' Choose the correct connection (either PC to device or device to PC), then confirm. After that, you can download your program. Make sure in [product_name] configuration software, you select the correct device type, located in the bottom right corner of your screen.

Hello, thank you for your reply. 1. I have set the module to STOP mode. 2. I did not understand the part regarding 'CARD.' 3. I have selected the correct [product_name] type in the configuration software. Despite trying to upload, I am still unsuccessful. Are there other steps needed? In the program/card section, I see symbols and am hesitant to continue. Please advise.

Yes, that symbol is necessary. The rectangle with a black section represents the [product_name]. You should establish the connection from the device to your PC. It is safe to try—this process will not damage your [product_name].
Hello [user_name]. Do you recall this issue? I am encountering the same problem now. If you resolved it, please share the solution.

Replying to this old discussion: This advice was very helpful! I received six old [product_name] devices and began programming—it's great to be able to find information in the archives here. Thanks to [company_name] for keeping older topics available.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users report persistent difficulties uploading programs from [product_name] devices of one version using [product_name] software and standard cables, despite correct settings and procedures. Identical steps work with other module versions, revealing unexplained communication reliability differences. Uncertainty about software interface symbols and next steps reflects unclear user guidance and usability gaps.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect seamless, consistent program upload functionality across all [product_name] hardware versions, reliable connectivity, and straightforward, clear instructions in the software interface to address troubleshooting.
